description: Source code for an EPUB document loader component, implementing INode interface, handling EPUB file input, metadata processing, and document extraction using langchain and filesystem operations.

classes.name: Epub_DocumentLoaders
classes.description: A class implementing INode to load and process EPUB files into documents.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the EPUB loader, processes input files, extracts documents, and returns either document objects or concatenated text.

methods.name: extractDocs
methods.description: Loads EPUB content using EPubLoader, splits documents if needed, and appends to the docs array.
